content:
We're rounding out our iPhone 18 Pro accessory picks for the year before Friday delivery. If you ask me, the Apple AirTag 2 and the new AirPods Pro 3 (or AirPods 5) are the best accessories you can buy, even better than the so-called best cleaning cloth in the world. But this time we'll be diving deeper—chargers, MagSafe stands, cases, wallets and more. Read on.

iPhone 18 Pro Accessories

  • Chance — Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max
  • Ben — Apple TechWoven Case
  • Michael — Anker Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 Foldable MagSafe Charger
  • Arin — Apple iPhone FineWoven Wallet with MagSafe
  • Ryan — MagSafe Car Mount for iPhone 18 Pro
  • Fernando — Burgundy Picogo Air Ultra Slim Power Bank
  • Simon — Baseus Enercore 70W Retractable USB-C Travel Adapter
  • Justin — Satechi 25W 3-in-1 Qi2 Stand
  • Reinette — Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case
  • Notable Recommendations

If you want to charge your new iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max at the fastest possible speed, you need a compatible charging brick. Specifically, you need a charger that supports Adjustable Voltage (AVS), and Apple's option is currently the best choice. It features a sleek foldable design and can charge your iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max to 50% in just 15 minutes.

The Apple TechWoven Case combines an attractive look, a comfortable grip, wonderfully tactile anodized aluminum buttons, and a range of deep, rich colorways—along with the eco-friendly ethos of being made from 100% recycled polyester.

Anker's compact 3-in-1 wireless charger can power three devices from a single portable accessory, and juice up your iPhone via MagSafe-compatible Qi2 wireless charging. It folds down to a very small size, making it easy to slip into a travel bag, so you can leave multiple cables and bricks at home—or keep your entire Apple device setup neatly organized on your nightstand or desk. It's now nearly 35% off, an all-time low on Amazon.

The Apple FineWoven Wallet with MagSafe has long been a must-have iPhone accessory for users who favor a minimalist style. It comfortably holds 3 to 4 cards—whether it's your ID, a couple of credit cards, or a key card—making it perfect for anyone who doesn't want to carry a bulky wallet.

Every time I drive, I want a secure and stable place to put my iPhone. The ESR MagSafe Car Mount is my top pick. You can magnetically attach your iPhone 18 Pro or an older model to the mount, and the mount easily clips onto your car's air vent. A MagSafe mount is a great way to keep your iPhone safe and visible, and to charge it while you drive.

I've always believed that MagSafe power banks designed for use on the go should be as thin as possible. Baseus has just launched what I consider the perfect MagSafe battery. The Picogo Air is only 0.27 inches thick and weighs just 3.7 ounces. It packs a 5,000mAh battery, with up to 7.5W wireless charging and 22.5W wired charging. Best of all, they already have a version in a Burgundy colorway that perfectly matches the new Burgundy iPhone. A good MagSafe battery should be made this way—with thinness as the priority.

If you travel frequently, you already know that keeping your tech bag organized is half the battle. That's why I've always had my eye out for all-in-one charging gear. Baseus's travel adapter fits the bill perfectly, supporting outlets in over 200 countries and capable of charging six devices simultaneously. But for me, the biggest draw is the built-in 70W retractable USB-C cable, which can charge your iPhone 18 Pro at full speed while also delivering steady power to an iPad, MacBook, and more.

Michael, whom I mentioned above, picked what I consider the best foldable MagSafe charger for travel, but I'll focus on two of my favorite desktop 3-in-1 options: the ultra-slim, beautifully minimalist 25W Satechi 3-in-1 Qi2 Stand, which comes in a gorgeous space black finish; I'm also a big fan of Anker's Smart Display 3-in-1 option, but the Satechi is simply too stylish and elegant to beat.

After spending a chunk of change on an iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max, I tend to go for more budget-friendly accessory options rather than the most premium ones. Spigen offers plenty of affordable MagSafe cases. My top pick is this clear Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case, priced well below other brands, or their colorful opaque versions—all of which support MagSafe for fast wireless charging. They also feature DuraClear side TPU panels infused with blue resin to effectively prevent yellowing, along with shock-absorbing design; the camera control button is also protected by a thin layer of TPU.

  • Anker 100W USB-C Smart Display Charger

  • Nomad iPhone 18 Pro Leather Case
  • Aulumu A18 Pro Shockproof Case
  • Twelve South Butterfly 2-in-1
